entries.reason: The advisory covers upstream zlib 1.3.1.2 through 1.3.2 gz_vacate; this package is zlib-ng 2.3.3 in ZLIB_COMPAT mode, whose source has no gz_vacate and whose 1.3.1 version is a compatibility label.
The advisory targets the contrib/untgz demonstration utility; this package builds the core library only and neither ships nor builds contrib/untgz.
zlib-ng 2.3.3 shares the signed x2nmodp loop; the upstream negative-length guard is not in a release yet, a recipe backport is tracked.
